I am an old man with only this small shamba of less than half a hectare. I have no schooling, and those expensive fertilizers and shop seeds are not for people like me. I will cultivate as I always have, using the local seeds I keep from last season and the strength of my family’s hands. I may pay a young man from the village for a few days to help with the heaviest digging, but we do not have money for chemicals or irrigation.
